title: SafeMo: Linguistically Grounded Unlearning for Trustworthy Text-to-Motion Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a trustworthy and safe text-to-motion generative framework. It aims to unlearn harmful or unsafe behaviors (such as violence or weapon use) to align the model with ethics and regulations. It also introduces SafeMoVAE-29K, a dataset designed to benchmark safe motion generation and unlearning.
